guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for ASE atoms properties by analyzing info and calculator results across a list of atoms
guess_target_metadata: guess whether a target property is per-atom or per-image based on atom lengths and sample shapes
check_target_extensive: check if a property is extensive by comparing per-atom normalized standard deviation against a threshold
check_target_per_atom: check if a target is per-atom by verifying the first dimension matches atom count across samples
check_uniform_atoms_lengths: check if all structures in a dataset have the same number of atoms
